comment: PropSpec behaviour golden for the TS render path. Its one consumer is propSpecGolden.test.ts, which asserts per variant that the declared default self-validates, that `valid` samples survive canonicalizePropsLenient, and that `invalid` ones fall back to the default (the cross-language Rust validator this file was once shared with no longer exists — the catalog is TS-only). Every PropSpec variant must appear here. Each `valid`/`invalid` sample must differ from `spec.default` so the lenient-fallback check can tell kept-from-replaced.
